seo.title: What We Do | Kasi Transport
seo.description: Linehaul and contract logistics, commercial transportation, event and production logistics and specialised transport across Peninsular Malaysia, from Kasi Transport in Petaling Jaya.

intro.title: Transport solutions for your business.
intro.text: From scheduled linehaul to live production logistics, we move cargo and equipment across Peninsular Malaysia with company-operated vehicles and a network of transport partners.

solutions.title: One operation, four ways to move.

items.title: Linehaul & Contract Logistics
items.tagline: Scheduled hub-to-hub transfers and recurring transport.
items.text: Our flagship service for businesses that need freight moved between hubs on a fixed schedule, week after week, with the same team planning every run.

items.title: Commercial Transportation
items.tagline: Cargo deliveries and stock movements between business locations.
items.text: Reliable transport for the everyday movement of goods, from stock transfers between sites to deliveries to your customers.

items.title: Event & Production Logistics
items.tagline: Equipment transport planned around venue access and production schedules.
items.text: Years of experience moving staging, sound, lighting and production equipment for concerts and festivals, where load-in times leave no room for delay.

items.title: Specialised Transportation
items.tagline: Transport enquiries for loads with specific vehicle or handling needs.
items.text: When a load needs more than a standard truck, tell us what you are moving and we will discuss the right vehicle and handling.

industries.title: Transport for your industry.
industries.text: The kinds of organisations we can support, from parcel networks to production crews.

items.title: Events and entertainment
items.text: Move production equipment around venue schedules.

items.title: Recurring routes
items.text: Fixed schedules and long-term arrangements for freight that moves regularly.

items.title: Dedicated vehicles
items.text: Vehicles and drivers assigned to your operation, so the same people know your sites.

items.title: One-off moves
items.text: A single delivery, relocation or production. Share the details and we will quote.
